oe_chr_emdw_is_wait = { NOT = { oe_chr_emdw_void = yes } NOT = { oe_chr_emdw_done = yes } NOT = { oe_chr_emdw_run = yes } }

# 1402–1413 奥斯曼空位期 (The Ottoman Interregnum)
oe_chr_ivr_void = { OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun } OR = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_done } NOT = { var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 } OR = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } } } }
oe_chr_ivr_done = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_done }
oe_chr_ivr_run = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun }
